title: 2.1 Characteristics of Animals
description: Exhaustive quiz covering the general biological characteristics and taxonomic classification of animals.

questions.question: Which cellular characteristic is shared by all animals?
options: They possess rigid cell walls made of cellulose

questions.question: How do animals obtain their nutrition according to their fundamental characteristics?
options: They synthesize their own organic molecules via light energy
They absorb nutrients exclusively through inorganic chemosynthesis
They rely entirely on parasitic saprophytic absorption

questions.question: Which major group of animals includes birds and mammals characterized by maintaining a constant internal body temperature?
Which category of vertebrate animals includes fish, reptiles, and amphibians whose body temperatures vary with the environment?
